policy: Source conditions, handwritten answers and independent calculations remain separate. Six E1 types are released; the other five remain locked. No claim of full E1 completion or validation of the legacy generic 3D renderer.

learnerStackBank.easy: Give one occupied cell's height, reducing independent reconstruction search.
learnerStackBank.source: Keep original three projections; Example 4 also keeps total, Mission 3 adds no total.
learnerStackBank.hard: Example 4 first derives total from floor cells and added cubes. Mission 3 first derives a missing front height from the two-column sum.
learnerStackBank.difficultyLimit: Structural source-level match, not empirical student calibration.
learnerStackBank.reviewLimit: Prior independent model/renderer reviewer evidence is retained. Current learner-visible voxel enumeration is a separate calculation implementation, not a new secondary-agent review.
learnerStackBank.visualReview: Primary direct eyes sampled original-level A4 problem/solution, hard Mission 3 A4 problem/answer key, easy 320px problem and original 320px solution. Automated bounds and exact answer pixels cover all eighteen PDFs.

verification.visualReview: Direct source, desktop, mobile and A4 raster inspection; independent sampled eyes confirmed final equation wrapping, normal font, grid directions and source sum. An initial low-resolution footprint misreading was retracted after enlarged raster and re-enumeration. Not an eye check of all twenty-four PDFs.
verification.difficultyLimit: Source level preserves each task. Easier adds a useful scaffold. Harder reconstructs a height, derives total from floor and added cubes, or converts edge length to unit face area before the source task. No empirical student difficulty calibration claimed.
verification.secondaryMathReviewer: Existing read-only agent; learner SVG inputs and independent voxel/camera calculations, not producer answers or model metadata.
verification.scopeLimit: No validation of the legacy isometric cube renderer. The four released types use source-derived 2D height charts and orthographic grids.

locked3DModelReview.pixelNegativeControl: Normal reference rejects a highest cube actually removed from the GPU scene; a wrong near-edge color is rejected without a broad face-edge exemption.
locked3DModelReview.sourceTotalContract: Example 4 retains eight cubes. Mission 3 has no total clue.
locked3DModelReview.renderingContract: Opaque unit cubes, orthographic camera, depth-tested black edges, source directions; same-font direction labels inside decoded canonical PNG.
locked3DModelReview.scopeLimit: Internal model-review page only. No learner bank generation, difficulty approval, printed fallback integration or release claimed.
